diagnosis.observedMessage: Unable to record STS API outcome.
diagnosis.cause: The target STS trust rejection returned through a nested IAM Update, poisoning the enclosing EKS write. Mandatory STS rejection recording then encountered the same failed transaction and replaced the authorization error with InternalFailure.
diagnosis.scope: This target-chain rejection bug is separate from race-instrumentation latency. No timeout, retry policy or denied-result assertion was weakened.
diagnosis.implementation: IAM authority commands now use existing native Attempt/savepoint semantics. STS rejection projections use existing retained outcomes. EKS records the retained rejection only after its failed exchange has rolled back; successful issuance records remain atomic with their credentials.
diagnosis.postFixVerification: Ordinary uninstrumented /tmp/stackd-eks-sts-outcome-bin: the nine remaining strict cases passed in 174.70s with no cleanup error. All three SDK attempts at the target TagSession boundary recorded real STS AccessDenied followed by EKS AccessDeniedException, with zero matching successful issuance events or credential rows. Existing positive credentials remained after role cleanup, so the zero count is not a cleanup artifact. See eks_pod_identity_strict_completion.json.
